title: Crane Buildings and Crane Systems in PEB | Steel Mind
description: Steel buildings designed for overhead cranes. Learn how crane loads, runway beams and column brackets are built into a PEB in Pakistan.
keyword: PEB with overhead crane in Pakistan
h1: Crane System: Pre-Engineered Buildings Designed for Overhead Cranes
quickAnswer: A PEB that carries an overhead crane needs stronger columns, accurate runway beams and extra bracing, all designed from the start. Steel Mind built crane sheds of 96,600 and 97,888 square feet for Haier at Raiwind.
alt: Crane arrangements for pre-engineered buildings: jib, semi-gantry, top-running and underhung.

faq.q: Can I add a crane later?
faq.a: Only if the building was designed for it. Say so at the quote stage, even if the crane will come in a later year.

faq.q: What details does the engineer need for a crane building?
faq.a: The crane capacity, span, lifting height, number of cranes and working frequency.

blocks.title: Why Crane Buildings Need Special Design

blocks.text: An overhead crane adds large, moving loads to the frame. The columns must be stronger, and the runway beams must be accurate. A building that was not designed for a crane cannot safely carry one. Tell the engineer about the crane at the start, even if it will arrive years later.

items.name: Jib crane and monorail crane
items.text: A jib crane serves a circle around a column or wall. A monorail crane moves loads along one fixed track. Both suit workstations and assembly lines.

items.name: Semi-gantry crane
items.text: One end of the crane runs on a rail on the building column and the other on a floor-mounted leg. It suits yards and partly covered areas.

items.name: Top-running crane in a clear-span building
items.text: A bridge crane runs on rails on top of crane beams across the full width of a column-free building. It gives the widest lifting coverage and the highest capacity.

items.name: Top-running crane in a multi-span building
items.text: The same principle in a building with inner columns, with a crane in each bay.

items.name: Underhung crane
items.text: A crane hung from the underside of the roof structure. It saves floor space and suits lighter loads.

blocks.text: Crane columns carry the runway beams through brackets or a stepped section. Runway beams hold the crane rails and must be level and straight. Extra bracing resists the sideways and braking forces of the crane. The clear height must suit the crane hook and the loads it lifts.
Give the crane capacity, the crane span, the lifting height, the number of cranes and how often they work. The crane maker can provide the wheel loads.

Steel Mind built a PEB crane shed of 96,600 square feet for Haier at Raiwind, with a height of 30 feet, a width of 184 feet and a length of 525 feet. It also built a PEB crane and mezzanine shed of 97,888 square feet for Haier, 33 feet high, 184 feet wide and 532 feet long. See the Crane Sheds page and the project pages.
